projects.name: AdFlow Network
projects.summary: A cloud platform where brands upload video ads that play on screens in local supershops — one dashboard controls every screen in real time.
projects.outcome: Playlist changes reach screens instantly — no refresh needed.
projects.description: Any device becomes a digital screen by opening a short screen code (player/XX-0000). The admin dashboard manages screens, ads, playlists and locations, while a Socket.IO channel pushes playlist assignments to devices and streams their heartbeat back so Online/Offline status updates live. Videos are stored on Cloudinary and data lives in MongoDB Atlas behind a REST API built with Express.
highlights: Real-time: Socket.IO between the admin dashboard and screen devices.
REST API for ads, screens, playlists, locations, dashboard stats and users.
Deployment: Vercel frontend, Render backend, MongoDB Atlas, Cloudinary media.

architecture.label: Playlist push
architecture.explanation: Assignments are pushed to the device instantly — the player updates without a page refresh.

architecture.label: Heartbeat
architecture.explanation: Each screen sends a heartbeat to stay Online; the admin panel reflects status changes live.

projects.name: BRIQ
projects.category: Premium red bricks · Interactive product site
projects.summary: A cinematic, motion-driven storefront for premium red bricks built with React Three Fiber, GSAP and smooth scrolling.
projects.outcome: A full storefront flow — story, shop, cart and contact — in one scroll.
projects.description: BRIQ pairs a 3D featured-brick scene (React Three Fiber + drei) and a particle canvas with a GSAP-driven cinematic sequence and Lenis smooth scrolling. A Zustand store powers the shop and slide-out cart drawer, and the site is written end to end in TypeScript.
highlights: 3D: React Three Fiber scene with a featured brick and particle effects.
State: Zustand store shared by the shop grid and cart drawer.

projects.name: Ad Click Prediction
projects.summary: Predicts whether a social-network user will click an ad from gender, age and estimated salary, served through a Gradio interface.
projects.outcome: Returns a click / no-click verdict with its predicted probability.
projects.description: A clean scikit-learn workflow: a ColumnTransformer scales numerical features and one-hot encodes gender, feeding a logistic-regression model chosen for a small, tabular binary-classification problem. The pipeline is validated with 5-fold cross-validation, tuned with GridSearchCV over the regularisation strength, evaluated with a classification report and confusion matrix, then pickled and served through a Gradio app with sliders for age and salary.
highlights: Leak-free preprocessing inside a single scikit-learn Pipeline.
Model selection with 5-fold CV and GridSearchCV hyper-parameter tuning.

projects.name: MindBalance
projects.summary: A TypeScript React app with Firebase authentication (including Google sign-in), service pages and an appointment booking flow.
projects.outcome: Users sign up, browse services and book appointments in one flow.
projects.description: Organised by feature: an auth module (email/password registration, login and Google sign-in via Firebase) and a booking module with an appointment form, alongside services and about pages. The UI is built from accessible Radix-based primitives styled with Tailwind CSS, with toast feedback and motion.
highlights: Feature-based folder structure: auth, booking, layouts, pages.
Reusable UI primitives (button, card, input, label) with class-variance-authority.

projects.name: Chatting App
projects.summary: A Firebase-backed chat dashboard with conversations, a friends list and friend requests, built in TypeScript.
projects.outcome: A sidebar dashboard for chats, friends and incoming requests.
projects.description: A dashboard layout with a collapsible app sidebar routes between chats, friends and requests. Conversations open in a chat window with a dialog for starting new ones, and Firebase handles authentication and data.
highlights: Dashboard shell with sidebar navigation and a responsive mobile hook.

projects.name: Task Kanban
projects.summary: A Kanban-style task manager with Firebase authentication and a column-based dashboard, written in TypeScript.
projects.outcome: Signed-in users organise tasks across board columns.
projects.description: Typed task models feed a dashboard of columns and task cards, with an auth page in front and Firebase as the backend.
highlights: Strongly typed task model shared across columns and cards.
